mechanism: retry one alternative ready wave when a primary candidate fails 2-port RF bank admission
law: isolated contested slot: delta E[issue]=Pr(primary conflicts)*Pr(backup admissible | primary conflicts); 4-slot downstream displacement is a negative correction

holdouts.prediction: positive: bank conflict with diverse backups
positive but weaker under saturated hot banks
negative control: no bank conflict and no fallback
small or no improvement when issue demand low
